lines.zh: 我拖着很长的余影走过来。
lines.en: I come dragging a long after-image.

lines.zh: 我每一步都留在上一格。
lines.en: Each step of mine stays behind a block.
I shift slowly toward you.
Half of my body is here.
I come, and the light shudders with me.
I walk half an inch above the ground.

lines.zh: 我的衣摆散成很细的灰。
lines.en: My hem frays into fine ash.
I pass through the wall.
I walk unhurried and never look back.
My after-image trails one block behind.
I round a pillar and it pales.
I approach step by step.

lines.zh: 我站着，身后还有一个我。
lines.en: I stand and there is another me behind.
My shape is not quite steady.
I stay still as ash falls.
There is a little light in my sockets.
I hold a hand at my chest.
I am recalling a former life.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼吸，其实没有。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, though not at all.
I wait for you to be ready.
My cloak reaches the floor.

lines.zh: 我安静得像一段被删掉的话。
lines.en: I am quiet as a deleted line.
I turn my head to the distance.
I have no reason to rush.
I stand between light and not.

lines.zh: 我等 Speech 之后的那场。
lines.en: I wait for the fight after Speech.

lines.zh: 我的手指穿过自己的身体。
lines.en: My fingers pass through my own body.
I raise my eyes and see you.
Half my face is unclear.
In this life you are fairly strong.
I nod once, slowly.
My hand reaches toward you.
I tilt my head, comparing something.
You carry old scars.
My gaze settles lightly.
I wait for you to give your name.
My outline wavers in your eyes.
I smile, most likely not.

lines.zh: 你召唤了我，现在看清我的脸。
lines.en: You summoned me; now look at my face.
You were called here, not by chance.
We are at the same height.
I look at you seriously.
I knew you would come.
I withdraw a block and reset.
More ash falls from me.
My outline fades for an instant.
I make no sound at all.
My after-image lags a beat.
Light leaks out of me.
I slowly correct my posture.
I stare at you, calm.
I glance and do not reach.
These cannot hold me.
I lift a hand and it floats.
I care more about your strength.
It fades on my side.
I shake my head very slowly.

lines.zh: 石台上的供品，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the offering on the stone slab.
You need not bribe me.
You hit me like hitting water.
My body yields and closes.
You pass through me and it is cold.
Our shadows overlap for an instant.
I am pushed back a block.
A layer of ash stays on your hand.

lines.zh: 我们之间发出很轻的响。
lines.en: A faint sound comes from between us.
I raise a hand to your shoulder.
You touched nothing solid.

lines.zh: 我的残像在你身后重了。
lines.en: My after-image thickens behind you.
Two vestiges stand facing each other.
Parts of us overlap.
She says nothing; neither do I.
Our ash settles together.
We raise our hands at once.
Her outline surrounds me.

lines.zh: 我们一起看向同一个方向。
lines.en: We look the same way.
Our after-images trail one behind the other.
Her light and mine come close.
We both fade very pale.
I hold it through the air.
I look and put it back.

lines.zh: 它在我手里落了一层灰。
lines.en: It gathers ash in my hand.
I draw it into my robe.

lines.zh: 它穿过我的手指掉下去。
lines.en: It falls through my fingers.
I spin it around a finger.
I leave it on the ground.

lines.zh: 拎起我，就等于拎起角落。
lines.en: Lift me and you lift the corner itself.
I turn my whole body.
This life of mine has chosen you.

lines.zh: 我的灰开始往你那边飘。
lines.en: My ash starts drifting your way.
I raise both hands.

lines.zh: 我知道什么时候该开始。
lines.en: I know when to begin.
Your position is fixed.
I take one slow step forward.
I will wait no longer.
Light gathers at my side.

lines.zh: 我身后那个我也转过来。
lines.en: The me behind turns too.
My outline sharpens.
This fight is mine to enter.
I follow you slowly.
You run; my ash arrives first.
You circle twice; I am still here.
My after-image is behind you.
I pass through walls, never detouring.
You hear a faint sound of sand.
I approach bit by bit.
You raise the lamp; I fade.
I wait at the stairwell for you to come down.

lines.zh: 你身后那面墙，挡住了退路。
lines.en: The wall behind you cuts off your retreat.
My ash covers the ground at your feet.

lines.zh: 我从上面落下来，不发声。
lines.en: I drop from above without a sound.
I bring a hand down on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的伤口在你身上开了。
lines.en: My wound opens on you.
A rush of ash pushes you.
My fingertips cross your face.
It is light, and very cold.

lines.zh: 第一阶段的我，只抓不撕。
lines.en: In my first phase, I only grip, not tear.
You pull away; the ash stays.
I press you backward.

lines.zh: 你挡住我，手臂一阵发麻。
lines.en: You block me and your arm goes numb.
A layer of ash enters the air.

lines.zh: 你召来了不该召的东西。
lines.en: You called something you should not have.

lines.zh: 我从召唤的光里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the summoning light.
My after-image appears first.

lines.zh: 房间里多了一段旧时间。
lines.en: The room has gained a piece of old time.
I stand in the center of the circle.
The lamplight turns yellower.
A pale ring appears on the floor.
I begin to exist, very lightly.
My hem drops first.

lines.zh: 你听见有人在很远的地方叹气。
lines.en: You hear a sigh from far away.
A seam in this world has opened.
I slowly come into focus.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西还在发热。
lines.en: What you hold is still warm.

lines.zh: 我从那道缝里被拉出来。
lines.en: I am drawn out of that seam.

lines.zh: 我的影子比墙上的多一个。
lines.en: There is one more shadow than there should be.

lines.zh: 火烧过来，我的灰亮了一片。
lines.en: Fire comes and my ash glows.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，落地时散成粉。
lines.en: I fall and scatter into powder on landing.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的残像吹散了。
lines.en: The blast blows my after-image apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，我多了一个洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 那股力量与我同源，却咬了回来。
lines.en: That force is like mine, and it bites back.

lines.zh: 召唤我的时候，没人喂过我。
lines.en: No one fed me when they summoned me.

lines.zh: 雷落下，我的轮廓全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning falls and my outline lights up.

lines.zh: 我往下沉，沉进更空的地方。
lines.en: I sink into somewhere emptier.
